info.title: Tidepool Agent API (NEAR testnet)
info.description: A testnet implementation of the NEAR Intents Agent API shape, on the same host as the /v0 1Click sandbox. Compatible with @near-intents-agent-api/sdk (set baseUrl to the Tidepool origin; the SDK appends /v1). Owners are NEAR testnet accounts only. Withdrawals go to NEAR accounts or, for bridged tokens, to every testnet /v0 pays out on (including BSC Testnet and Hyperliquid testnet / HyperCore, when live), with an optional memo on near, stellar, xrp (destination tag) and sol. GET /v1/tokens lists the default /v0 token set (BSC USDC/USDT included when that route is live); Ondo tokenized stocks/RWAs are not listed here — they stay behind GET /v0/tokens?ondoTokens=1 and cannot be used as /v1 asset ids. Owner approvals (owner_approval), timelock_ms and schedule are supported: held work is PENDING_APPROVAL or QUEUED, listed at /v1/agents/{id}/approvals and /v1/agents/{id}/executions/scheduled, voted with approval_vote and cancelled with execution_cancel. Confidential mode, passkey/EVM owners, shielding, containment, native wallets, per-agent releases and proofs are not supported. Get a free key with POST /v1/keys. testnet_faucet on deposit answers 403 site_only; claim tokens at https://app.usetidepool.tech/faucet. Errors are JSON:API: {errors:[{status,code,layer,title,detail,source,meta}],meta:{request_id}}. Docs: /docs/guides/agent-api, /llms.txt.

Use asset_id values in swaps, transfers, withdrawals and policies. This is the default /v0 token list (including BSC Testnet USDC/USDT when that route is live). Ondo tokenized stocks/RWAs are not included; request them with GET /v0/tokens?ondoTokens=1. They cannot be used as /v1 asset ids.

post.summary: Build an owner intent to sign
post.description: Types: agent_create, grant_issue, grant_revoke, policy_update, agent_freeze, agent_unfreeze, execution_cancel (correlation_id of QUEUED or PENDING_APPROVAL work; 409 execution_not_cancellable otherwise), approval_vote (approval_id + verdict approve|reject; 409 approval_closed when no longer PENDING). Returns a nep413 payload (message, nonce, recipient) and a correlation_id. Sign with the owner ed25519 key, then POST /v1/submit-intent.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per action. Same key + same body replays the original execution; same key + different body returns 409 idempotency_conflict.

owner.description: Owner wallet for agent_create. Owner intents are then signed as nep413 (near), eip712 or erc191 (evm), or webauthn (passkey).

public_key.description: ed25519:<base58>, a full-access key of account_id
secp256k1 public key as 0x hex (compressed or uncompressed); must belong to address
P-256 key: base64url SPKI, or the uncompressed point 04... (hex or base64url)

credential.description: sha256 hex of the grant token string

correlation_id.description: execution_cancel: the QUEUED or PENDING_APPROVAL execution

signed_data.description: nep413: payload, public_key, signature (base64 ed25519 of the NEP-413 hash). eip712: payload (as generated), signature (eth_signTypedData_v4). erc191: payload {message: intent.payload.message.intent}, signature (personal_sign). webauthn: payload (as generated), credential (navigator.credentials.get result, base64url fields).

payload.description: The payload returned by generate-intent, unchanged (erc191: {message})

signature.description: nep413: base64 ed25519; eip712/erc191: 0x secp256k1 signature

get.summary: Status of an intent or action
get.description: Long-polls up to wait_ms (max 30000) until a terminal state: SUCCESS, FAILED, REFUNDED, UNCERTAIN, NEEDS_REVIEW.
Non-zero balances unless an asset filter is given.

post.description: dry:true needs only the API key and never refuses for policy or balance reasons: it returns warnings[]. A real swap needs x-grant-token and Idempotency-Key and is checked against the policy. With policy.owner_approval the 202 status is PENDING_APPROVAL (details.approval_id); with timelock_ms it is QUEUED (details.execute_after). Budget, limits and actions per hour are charged when held work dispatches.

post.summary: Withdraw to NEAR or a bridged chain
post.description: chain near: NEAR-native tokens to a NEAR account. Otherwise chain is the token blockchain (base, arb, eth, bsc, sol, stellar, sui, xrp, btc, zec, hypercore: exactly the testnets /v0 pays out on, as listed by GET /v1/tokens) and recipient an address on that chain. Same per-payout caps as /v0. memo: near (ft_withdraw memo, max 128 chars), stellar (uint64 number without leading zeros -> MEMO_ID, else MEMO_TEXT max 28 bytes), xrp (destination tag, 0-4294967295; an X-address recipient whose tag differs is refused), sol (SPL Memo program instruction, max 256 bytes). A memo on base/arb/eth/bsc/sui/btc/zec/hypercore answers 400 validation_failed at /memo. Policy destinations match on chain, address and memo. dry:true supported. Native ETH (nep141:eth.tp-omft.testnet, base.tp-omft.testnet, arb.tp-omft.testnet) can be withdrawn to an 0x address on Ethereum, Base or Arbitrum Sepolia but is capped at 0.006 ETH (6000000000000000 wei) per withdrawal, the same limit as /v0: more answers 400 route_unavailable at /amount, and 503 while the treasury is low. Ondo tokens are not withdrawable through /v1 (they are not in GET /v1/tokens). With policy.owner_approval the 202 status is PENDING_APPROVAL (details.approval_id); with timelock_ms it is QUEUED (details.execute_after). Budget, limits and actions per hour are charged when held work dispatches.

post.description: Returns a deposit address and waits (PENDING_DEPOSIT) until the balance rises. No grant token is needed; an Idempotency-Key is still required. testnet_faucet:true is turned off: it answers 403 site_only. Claim test tokens at https://app.usetidepool.tech/faucet and send them to the agent wallet.

429.description: rate_limited: the testnet faucet was used for this wallet within the last hour, or this IP hit its hourly faucet limit. Retry-After gives the wait in seconds.

get.description: PENDING approvals (policy.owner_approval), oldest first. Vote with an approval_vote owner intent.
Any status: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED or EXPIRED.

get.summary: List executions the timelock holds, earliest release first
get.description: QUEUED work with execute_after; state is waiting or dispatching. Follow next_cursor.

details.description: tx_hash, amount_out, agent_id, grant, ... Held work also carries execute_after, delay_ms and (owner_approval) approval_id.

Policy.description: Enforced off-chain by the API; changes apply immediately. confidential must be false. owner_approval, timelock_ms and schedule are supported (see the guide): held work is PENDING_APPROVAL or QUEUED and is judged again (grant, policy, budget, limits, schedule, balance) when it dispatches.

limits.description: per_transaction | hourly | daily | monthly -> { asset_id: atomic amount }

destinations.description: mode "only" allows just the listed destinations, "except" blocks them, "any" ignores the list. ("allowlist"/"denylist" are not accepted: 400 validation_failed.)

chain.description: near, base, arb, eth, bsc, sol, stellar, sui, xrp, btc, zec

budget.description: USD budget keys (decimal strings, null = off); see the guide

owner_approval.description: true: every swap, transfer and withdraw waits in PENDING_APPROVAL until the owner signs an approval_vote intent (approvals expire after 24 hours, then the work ends FAILED approval_expired). Deposits are never held.

timelock_ms.description: Delay before every money action runs (deposits excepted). The work is QUEUED with details.execute_after and released by the worker; cancel it with an execution_cancel intent.

schedule.description: Optional weekly windows in an IANA time zone. mode only: actions run inside a window; except: outside every window. A request outside the schedule is refused 403 policy_schedule_denied with meta.available_at; held work waits for the next window (execute_after).
